suggest.repair: Repair the tables on this sheet
suggest.name: Name all the tables in the workbook automatically.
suggest.analysis: Suggest an analysis of my data
suggest.pivot: Create a relevant PivotTable with a chart
suggest.analyze: Analyze {table} ({n, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}})

summary.sample: it sees the workbook's structure and a few sample rows on each read (20 at most).
summary.full: it can read the entire content of the workbook.
summary.schema: it sees the workbook's structure (sheets, tables, columns, types), without the cell values.

undo.tooltip: Undoes in one go what {client} changed in this series
undo.label: Undo these changes

external.intro: Open Claude Desktop or Claude Code and ask, for example, “What does my Lattis workbook contain?”: each action will appear here.

confirm.label: Ask before changing
confirm.help: Lattis asks for your approval before each change to the workbook; reads go through without asking.

setup.intro: With a Claude subscription (Pro, Max, Team), you don't need an API key: you chat in Claude Desktop or Claude Code, which acts on the open workbook, and Lattis shows what is done.

sharing.before: The “Data sent to the assistant” setting (File › Settings › AI Assistant) also applies to Claude:
sharing.after: After a change, restart Claude so that it sees the new list of tools.

desktop.help: Claude's desktop app. Lattis appears in the conversation's tools.
desktop.done: Configured ✓ — restart Claude Desktop (quit it completely, then open it again).

code.help: Claude's assistant in the terminal (or in its desktop app). Lattis is added for all your projects.

done.before: Configured ✓ — open a new Claude Code session:

code.notFound: claude command not found on this computer

connect.keySaved: Key saved in the system keychain.
connect.keyValid: Valid key: it is saved in the system keychain.
connect.title: Connect the assistant
connect.managed: The provider and the model are chosen by your organization, which routes the assistant through its gateway.
connect.gatewayNoKey: Connected through your organization's gateway: there is no key to enter.
connect.gatewayKeySaved: Your personal key for the gateway is saved in the system keychain.
connect.gatewayPaste: Paste the personal key your organization gave you for its gateway.

desktop.tooltip: Drive Lattis from Claude Desktop or Claude Code (MCP server)
desktop.label: Desktop app
desktop.help: A provider's desktop app drives Lattis with your subscription to that provider, without an API key.

claude.before: A Claude subscription can't be used directly in another application, but
claude.after: can drive Lattis. You talk to Claude in its app; Lattis shows what it does (“From Claude”) and can undo everything.

desktop.needsDesktop: This method requires the Lattis desktop app.
desktop.maxTeam: Max or Team subscribers: your monthly API credits also pay for an API key (“API key” tab), which keeps the conversation in Lattis.

local.help: The model runs on this computer (Ollama, LM Studio…): no data leaves the computer, and there is no key.
local.experimental: Experimental: small models are worse at calling Lattis's tools.

connect.keyStored: A {provider} API key is saved in the system keychain.

step1.credits: A new key only works with credits: add some in
step1.maxTeam: Claude Max or Team subscriber? Link this organization in claude.ai › Settings › Billing to receive your monthly API credits ($100 to $500).
step1.other: Depending on the provider, the account needs credits or a payment method.

step3.keychain: The key is kept in the system keychain, never in the workbook.

panel.title: AI Assistant

connect.label: Connection
connect.tooltip: Connection: API key, Claude subscription, model

new.label: New
new.tooltip: New conversation (the current conversation stays in the list)

panel.unavailable: The assistant is not available in this version.

enable.title: Turn on the assistant
enable.intro: The AI Assistant reads the structure of your tables, suggests an approach and can add calculated columns, keys, PivotTables and charts. Everything it changes in one answer can be undone in one go.
enable.how: It goes through an AI provider with your API key, through a model installed on this computer, or through Claude Desktop with your Claude subscription. It never receives the whole workbook.
enable.locked: The AI Assistant is turned off by your organization's policy.
enable.settings: Also available in File › Settings › Features.

panel.empty: Describe what you want to analyze: the assistant reads the workbook's structure, suggests an approach and can create calculated columns, keys, PivotTables and charts.
panel.noDoc: First open or create a workbook (File › New).
panel.compact: Earlier messages were summarized for the assistant; they are still shown here

undo.later: Other changes came after it: use Ctrl+Z
undo.label: Undo this answer

panel.resume: Resumes the answer where it stopped

link.question: Open this link suggested by the assistant? Everything in its address is sent to

panel.contextTooltip: Attached to each message: the assistant knows what you are looking at

message.placeholder: Your message (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

panel.sharingTooltip: Data sent to the assistant (File › Settings › AI Assistant)
panel.costTooltip: Approximate cost based on the tokens used, billed by the provider
